sourcePolicy: Three genuine French Android 1.0.16 (19) captures obtained with user-authorized official adb in a fresh isolated local API 35 emulator. Existing APK installed; no app source modifications or rebuild. Four compositions; rewards and candidate images reuse the same actual game capture. Only Android system bars cropped, entire app uniformly scaled, captions outside UI; no repainting or AI bitmap assets.
